normal.name: Jakob Fel
normal.text: I've been playing BioWare's "golden age" games since the announcement of their closing and man, it still hasn't sunken in just how tragic it is to lose them. Yes, modern BioWare was a mess and needed to end somehow, but their legacy ending so unceremoniously really sucks for those of us who loved their games for so long. :sad_guilded: #bioware #rpg #masseffect #dragonage

normal.name: Silverfauve
normal.text: I just found out the firm that build my #gaming pc went belly up. It’s almost 3 years old, so not much warranty left to begin with but it is still annoying. My cpu air cooler keeps acting up, making a lot of noise at start up, sometimes it keeps at it and sometimes it quiets down, and this is before I even have started a game. The noise seems to have nothing to do with the performance I ask of the pc. It is a Jonsbo, some cheap Chinese brand so I guess it is about time I put something better in.
